turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
send a tracking number?
menu
Standard orders have a processing time of 3 to 5 business days before they ship, regardless of the shipping method chosen at checkout.
Once your order is fulfilled and handed over to the courier, a tracking number is automatically generated and sent to your email. Please allow up to 72 hours after receiving your tracking number for the carrier status to update.
If you'd like me to look up your specific order status, please share your order number and email address!

turns.q: Once it ships, how long is delivery?
turns.replyTail:
Here to help you shop
menu
Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Delivery times depend on the shipping method selected at checkout once the 3 to 5 business day processing period is complete.
For US domestic orders, standard economy shipping typically takes 7 to 10 business days, while standard domestic shipping takes 3 to 5 business days.
If you selected US Domestic Overnight Delivery (placed before 10:30 AM PST Monday through Friday), it will be delivered the next business day after processing.
